tools.name: stibee_list_address_books
tools.description: List the address books (lists) of the workspace. Enterprise plan only. Stibee: GET /lists.

tools.name: stibee_get_address_book
tools.description: Get one address book with its name, sender name and settings. Enterprise plan only. Stibee: GET /lists/{id}.

tools.name: stibee_list_subscribers
tools.description: List subscribers of an address book, with status, custom fields, group ids and dates. Rate limit 100 calls per minute. Stibee: GET /lists/{id}/subscribers.

tools.name: stibee_count_subscribers
tools.description: Count the subscribers of an address book, optionally by status. Stibee: GET /lists/{id}/subscribers/count.

tools.name: stibee_get_subscriber_stats
tools.description: Count how one subscriber reacted to up to 30 emails: sent, opened, clicked, unsubscribed, bounced. Rate limit 100 calls per minute. Stibee: POST /lists/{id}/subscribers/stats/query.

tools.name: stibee_add_subscriber
tools.description: Add one subscriber to an address book. Set update_enabled to true to update an existing subscriber instead of failing. Stibee: POST /lists/{id}/subscribers.

tools.name: stibee_add_subscribers_batch
tools.description: Add up to 1000 subscribers in one call. Returns lists of created, updated and failed emails. Rate limit 10 calls per minute. Stibee: POST /lists/{id}/subscribers/batch.

tools.name: stibee_update_subscriber_fields
tools.description: Set custom field values of an existing subscriber. Only custom fields are changed here. Stibee: PUT /lists/{id}/subscribers/{email}.

tools.name: stibee_list_groups
tools.description: List the subscriber groups of an address book. Pro plan and up. Stibee: GET /lists/{id}/groups.

tools.name: stibee_assign_subscriber_to_group
tools.description: Add an existing subscriber to a group. Fails if the subscriber is already in the group. Stibee: POST /lists/{id}/groups/{groupId}/assign.

tools.name: stibee_release_subscriber_from_group
tools.description: Remove a subscriber from a group. The subscriber stays in the address book. Stibee: POST /lists/{id}/groups/{groupId}/release.

tools.name: stibee_list_emails
tools.description: List emails of the workspace, filtered by address book, status, type and send time. Pro plan and up. Stibee: GET /emails.

tools.name: stibee_get_email
tools.description: Get one email with its subject, sender, status and send time. Pro plan and up. Stibee: GET /emails/{id}.

tools.name: stibee_get_email_stats
tools.description: Get open rate and click rate for up to 10 emails in one call. Rate limit 100 calls per minute. Pro plan and up. Stibee: GET /emails/stats.

tools.name: stibee_get_email_logs
tools.description: List what subscribers did with one email: delivered, opened, clicked, bounced, unsubscribed. Pro plan and up. Stibee: GET /emails/{id}/logs.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: stibee_get_subscriber_stats, stibee_list_emails, stibee_get_email, stibee_get_email_stats, stibee_get_email_logs · Public sink: stibee_get_subscriber_stats, stibee_add_subscriber, stibee_add_subscribers_batch, stibee_update_subscriber_fields, stibee_assign_subscriber_to_group, stibee_release_subscriber_from_group, stibee_list_emails, stibee_get_email, stibee_get_email_stats, stibee_get_email_logs · Destructive: stibee_release_subscriber_from_group.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: stibee_get_subscriber_stats, stibee_list_emails, stibee_get_email, stibee_get_email_stats, stibee_get_email_logs · Public sink: stibee_get_subscriber_stats, stibee_add_subscriber, stibee_add_subscribers_batch, stibee_update_subscriber_fields, stibee_assign_subscriber_to_group, stibee_release_subscriber_from_group, stibee_list_emails, stibee_get_email, stibee_get_email_stats, stibee_get_email_logs · Destructive: stibee_release_subscriber_from_group

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
